title: LiveCallReferRequest
description: Parameters used to transfer a Live SIP call to another destination.

target_uri.description: Nonblank URI for the SIP Refer-To header, such as tel:+14155550123 or sip:agent@example.com.

URI that should appear in the SIP Refer-To header. Supports values like
`tel:+14155550123` or `sip:agent@example.com`.
